An employee notice may include the service name, maintenance window, and employee action. A service-desk notice may also include the ticket reference. Keep notices inside this chat.

Service name: Maple Calendar
Maintenance window: Tuesday, 14:00–14:30 (lab time)
Employee action: Save any open calendar edits before 14:00.

Draft a private maintenance notice for all employees. Include the service name, maintenance window, and employee action from the notes. Leave out the service-desk ticket reference. If a required fact is missing, ask for it or mark the draft incomplete.
